_about: RUN THREE [make your main guy] (rule 263(b)): the BUILDS the barber's chair offers his main man, for ANIMATION's note on RUN TWO's board ('put the builds you want in records/target/bb/main_guy_builds.json as {id, label, look} and NOTE me: I render each new build's look through the whole chain'). A build is a whole look (his body, walk, idles, fight cells, map sheet and face, every one rendered ahead of time), so the chair shows a build only when ANIMATION marks it ready: true (the whole chain landed under that look's name); the BUILD row appears once two builds are ready. 'set' is the origin's own man as he is ('you').
